statement: A distinct dermal fibroblast lineage marked by Engrailed-1 expression carries intrinsic fibrogenic potential and is responsible for the bulk of scar formation in mouse skin wounds.

context.model: dorsal skin wounds; lineage tracing and transplantation

measurement.endpoint: contribution of the lineage to scar matrix
measurement.effect: the Engrailed-1 lineage produces the majority of connective tissue in scar; its ablation reduces scarring

evidence.note: establishes distinct fibroblast lineages determining dermal architecture

replication.note: Two groups (Longaker/Weissman; Watt) describing lineage heterogeneity with different markers; the Engrailed-1 result itself is one group.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
